title: Meeting and Greeting
ringkas: Memperkenalkan diri, bertanya kabar, dan menanggapi
goals: membalas **perkenalan dan sapaan** dalam bahasa Inggris

lesson.text: Pada level percakapan interaktif, kamu **mengetik balasanmu sendiri**. Jawaban dinilai dari kata kunci dan kemiripan dengan contoh, jadi jawablah dengan kalimat pendek yang wajar. Mulai dari perkenalan dan sapaan.

lesson.title: Ungkapan berguna
table: [[Nice to meet you. / See you later.]]

lines.en: Hi! I'm Dina. What's your name?
I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.

lesson.title: Cara berlatih
lesson.text: Ketik jawabanmu dengan kalimat pendek lalu bandingkan dengan contoh yang ditampilkan. Latihan bersuara membantu: ucapkan balasanmu sebelum mengetik.

items: Menanyakan kabar: [[How are you? / How's it going?]]
Menjawab kabar: [[I'm fine, thanks. And you?]]

practice.q: Good morning! How are you?
answers: Good morning! I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Good morning! I'm good, thanks. How about you?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Good morning! I'm fine, thank you. And you?  atau  Good morning! I'm good, thanks. How about you?  atau  Morning! I'm great. And you?

practice.q: Hi, I'm Tom. What's your name?
turns: Hi, I'm Tom. What's your name?
answers: Hi, Tom. My name is Rani.
I'm Rani. Nice to meet you.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Hi, Tom. My name is Rani.  atau  I'm Rani. Nice to meet you.  atau  Hello! I'm Rani.

practice.q: Nice to meet you!
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Nice to meet you too!  atau  Nice to meet you, too.  atau  Pleased to meet you.

practice.q: Where are you from?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm from Indonesia.  atau  I come from Indonesia.  atau  I'm from Indonesia. And you?

practice.q: How old are you?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm fourteen years old.  atau  I'm fourteen.  atau  I am fourteen years old.

practice.q: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
turns: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
answers: Yes, I have one younger brother.
Yes, I have a little sister.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, I have one younger brother.  atau  Yes, I have a little sister.  atau  I have one brother.

practice.q: What do you like to do?
turns: What do you like to do?
answers: I like reading and playing badminton.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I like reading and playing badminton.  atau  I enjoy playing football.  atau  I like listening to music.

practice.q: How are you today?
practice.scene: Seseorang menanyakan kabarmu, kamu sedang lelah.
answers: I'm a little tired, but OK.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm a little tired, but OK.  atau  I'm tired today.  atau  Not so good, I'm tired.

practice.q: Good afternoon!
answers: Good afternoon, Dina. How are you?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Good afternoon!  atau  Good afternoon, Dina. How are you?  atau  Hello! Good afternoon.

practice.q: Hi! Do you remember me?
practice.id: Jujur dan sopan katakan kamu lupa namanya.
answers: I'm sorry, I forgot your name.
Your face is familiar, but I forgot your name.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm sorry, I forgot your name.  atau  Sorry, what's your name again?  atau  Your face is familiar, but I forgot your name.

practice.q: I have to go now.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: OK, see you later!  atau  See you tomorrow.  atau  Bye! Nice talking to you.

practice.q: It was nice talking to you.
turns: It was nice talking to you.
answers: It was nice talking to you too.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: It was nice talking to you too.  atau  You too! See you soon.  atau  Me too, take care.

practice.q: Can I have your phone number?
turns: Can I have your phone number?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure, it's ...  atau  Of course. Here it is.  atau  Yes, sure.

practice.q: Thanks for your help!
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: You're welcome!  atau  No problem.  atau  My pleasure.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "How are you?"
practice.exp: Menjawab kabar.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Nice to meet you."
practice.exp: Membalas perkenalan.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Where are you from?"
practice.exp: Menjawab asal.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "What's your name?"
practice.exp: Menyebut nama.

practice.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Thanks for your help."
practice.exp: Membalas terima kasih.

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan perpisahan yang wajar:
practice.exp: Perpisahan. Jawaban yang tepat: **See you later!**

quiz.q: It was nice talking to you.
turns: It was nice talking to you.
answers: It was nice talking to you too.
quiz.exp: Contoh balasan: It was nice talking to you too.  atau  You too! See you soon.  atau  Me too, take care.

quiz.q: Can I have your phone number?
turns: Can I have your phone number?
quiz.exp: Contoh balasan: Sure, it's ...  atau  Of course. Here it is.  atau  Yes, sure.
Contoh balasan: You're welcome!  atau  No problem.  atau  My pleasure.

quiz.q: Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Nice to meet you."
Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Where are you from?"
Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "What's your name?"
Pilih balasan yang paling wajar untuk "Thanks for your help."

quiz.exp: Perpisahan. Jawaban yang tepat: **See you later!**
